goal: Build and verify a source-first legal-condition framework immune to testing-case contamination
limitations: Only seven protected normative modules are cryptographically pinned via committed mjs Git blob hashes.
Manifest and CI are stored in same repository; a malicious combined change could amend the manifest. GitHub branch protection with independent reviewer required to make this difficult to bypass.
No verified general provision-to-conditions rules have been approved, so the engine intentionally cannot determine a procedure.
No guarantee of coverage of all laws, exceptions, or routes; the verified V11 article excerpt index remains partial.
The independent reviewer is wired only to isolated KT83 PNI-V2 preview, not public production.
User-provided fact evidence remains to be separately authenticated by full dossier ingestion; not verified merely because submitted.
next_steps: Develop a source-only legal provision review schema with mandatory V11 article anchors, factual predicates, exceptions and competent authority with independent expert sign-off.
Complete source-indexed coverage for relevant general and special legislation before activating any automatic procedure.
Integrate verifiable document provenance from administrative case file reader; no rules or priorities from tests.
Add blind tests and branch review protection; then full real TEST_2 and unrelated dossier regressions, Word output and visual approval.
